# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, room additions, and ADUs in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley. Founded 2020. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, and Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

Design-build means one accountable team handles design, estimating, Ada and Canyon County permitting, and construction under one contract, backed by a written scope and a workmanship guarantee. 2026 planning ranges at a typical project size, from the on-site estimator: kitchen remodel $35k-$55k mid-range ($80k-$130k high-end); bathroom remodel $18k-$29k mid-range ($35k-$51k high-end); whole-home $108k-$180k mid-range ($216k-$310k high-end); room addition $96k-$136k mid-range ($160k-$224k high-end); ADU $168k-$240k mid-range ($240k-$336k high-end); basement finishing $36k-$61k mid-range ($72k-$115k high-end). These are estimated budget ranges, not quotes; a firm proposal follows an on-site consultation.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/kitchen-remodel): mid-range refresh to full-gut layout changes.
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/bathroom-remodel): guest baths to primary-suite renovations.
- [Whole-Home Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/whole-home-remodel): multi-room and full-house renovations.
- [Room Addition](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/room-addition): bump-outs, second stories, and new rooms.
- [ADU / Guest House](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/adu): garage conversions and detached new builds.
- [Basement Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/basement-remodel): finished basements, egress, and lower-level living space.
- [Outdoor Living & Decks](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/outdoor-living): decks, covered patios, and outdoor kitchens.
- [Aging-in-Place Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/aging-in-place): accessible, universal-design remodels.
- [RE-10 / Inspection Repairs](https://boiseremodeling.co/re-10-repairs-boise): repairs from an Idaho RE-10 inspection response, completed and documented before closing, for real estate agents, buyers and sellers.
- [Estimate From Your Plans](https://boiseremodeling.co/remodel-plans-boise): upload construction drawings and get a remodeling planning range built from the room areas, ceiling heights and schedules printed on the sheets, rather than from a stated square footage. Free, no obligation, and the homeowner confirms every measurement before anything is priced.
- [All Services](https://boiseremodeling.co/services): plus city pages at /services/{service}/{city} and [Service Areas](https://boiseremodeling.co/areas).
